fusions.name: Follow the Shaft
fusions.desc: A thrown barb that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets. You rush up to 7 tiles toward the target first.

fusions.name: Quick Jab
fusions.desc: A thrown jab that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Reach Out
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Skewer Mark
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
